item.title: Middleburg Heights ordinance prohibits sexual, violent offenders from parks, recreation facilities
item.description: The City of Middleburg Heights has passed and signed a new ordinance that aims to protect families and children from violent or sexual offenders.

item.title: WATCH: Eighth-grader makes stunning full court shot in Parma
item.description: It's the stuff of SportsCenter Top 10 dreams. One local basketball player made the shot of the game last Saturday, to the excitement of all in attendance.

item.title: Food stamp recipients sue USDA over restrictions on candy, energy drinks
item.description: Recipients of the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) filed a lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) on Wednesday challenging its food restriction waivers that reduce the types of foods that can be purchased with benefits.

item.title: Landmark Flats restaurant set to reopen
item.description: Shooters on the Water, a longtime landmark along the river, is set to welcome customers again on Wednesday, March 18.

item.title: Iowa resident allegedly laced lasagna with drugs, trying to cause woman to have miscarriage: Sheriff
item.description: An Iowa resident faces felony charges after allegedly lacing a pasta dish with opioids to force a pregnant woman to have a miscarriage, investigators said.

item.title: PHOTOS: Several Cuyahoga County sheriff deputies and employees honored
item.description: Several Cuyahoga County sheriff’s deputies, employees and citizens were honored on Thursday during the department's fourth annual Commendation and Awards Ceremony.

item.title: Videos recorded while Shaker Heights police officer on duty: I-Team
item.description: The FOX 8 I-Team has found a Shaker Heights police sergeant suspended for posting videos online recorded while on duty and in uniform.

item.title: Local shelter dog found on air base 7 years ago still looking for a home
item.description: Winger usually doesn't make much noise, especially when he's around friends. He's got a little bit of a lot of different dogs in him and is kind of shy when he first meets you or is in a new place.

item.title: Local Jewish community reacts after attack at Michigan synagogue: 'Sadness and shock'
item.description: As details emerged about the terrifying attack on Temple Israel in West Bloomfield, Michigan, members of the Ohio Jewish Caucus voiced deep concern about the crime that the FBI calls "a targeted act of violence against the Jewish community."

item.title: High Wind Warning: Gusts as high as 60 mph
item.description: Wind gusts as high as 60 mph are expected and could blow down trees and power lines. Travel will be difficult, especially for high-profile vehicles.
